d: One Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist has been reportedly killed in an ongoing encounter in the Laroo area of Kulgam district. The body has yet to be recovered. This encounter comes amid a massive search operation underway across several areas of Kulgam for the past six days. The joint operation involves the Army's 9 Rashtriya Rifles, the 18th Battalion of CRPF, and Jammu and Kashmir Police.
